subject: Error message when using the predict function

messages.author: 04f2bc1799d50dec
messages.subject: Error message when using the predict function
parts:
Dear forum

I am quite new to Program R, and unmarked, and am having difficulty with the predict() function. I think my problem may stem from incorrect specification of my covariates, however I have not been successful converting them to factors (if this is indeed what I should be doing).  While predict() has been discussed on the forum, I have not been able to translate any of the answers to my problem.

My data set consists of 21 surveys collected over 6 years at 30 camera sites. I am attempting to model black rat multi-state occupancy in relation to predator abundance, year, season, survey, and bait degradation. My code is as follows:

data<-read.csv("BR_21_surveys_22_and_40.csv")
#define the columns in the spreadsheet for the detection frame

y<-data[,2:841]

#specify number of sites

S<-nrow(data)

#J represents number of secondary sampling occasions e.g. 40 per survey

J<-40

#specify number of primary periods e.g. surveys

T<-21

#yearly covariate

year<-read.csv("year_cov.csv")

#covariate for season e.g. autumn, winter, spring, summer)

season<-read.csv("season_cov.csv")

season.cov=season

#Obscov for bait degradation given not all cameras are set on the same day

baitdegdata<-read.csv("BR_21_surveys_bait_deg.csv")

baitdeg<-baitdegdata[,2:841]

#covariate for change in camera model

camera.cov=data.frame(matrix(rep(c('p','p','p','p','p','p','p','p','p','p','p','s','s','s','s','s','s','s','s','s','s'),S),nrow=S,byrow=TRUE))

#covariate for predator abundance

#specify survey as a covariate

#to get obs covs and detections to match

sum(is.na(baitdeg) & !is.na(y))

which(is.na(baitdeg) & !is.na(y))

y[is.na(baitdeg)] <- NA

#construct unmarkedmultiframe

blackrats<-unmarkedMultFrame(y=y,numPrimary=21,siteCovs=data.frame(site=site),yearlySiteCovs=list(yearly.cov=yearly.cov,season.cov=season.cov,camera.cov=camera.cov,da.cov=da.cov,survey.cov=survey.cov),obsCovs=list(baitdeg=baitdeg))

summary(blackrats)

 

#now run some models

#covariates for detection

BR_det_camera<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~camera.cov,data=blackrats)

BR_det_season<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~season.cov, data=blackrats)

BR_det_da<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~da.cov, data=blackrats)

BR_det_baitdeg<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~baitdeg,data=blackrats)

BR_det_year<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~yearly.cov,data=blackrats)

BR_det_survey<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~survey.cov,data=blackrats)

BR_det_survey_camera<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~survey.cov+camera.cov,data=blackrats)

BR_det_survey_baitdeg<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~survey.cov+baitdeg,data=blackrats)

BR_det_survey_baitdeg_camera<-colext(psiformula=~1,gammaformula=~1,epsilonformula=~1,pformula=~survey.cov+baitdeg+camera.cov,data=blackrats)

fms<-fitList('psi0(.)col(.)ext(.),p(.)'=BRnull,'psi0(.),col(.),ext(.),p(camera)'=BR_det_camera,'psi0(.),col(.),ext(.),p(season)'=BR_det_season,'psi0(.),col(.),ext(.),p(devilabund)'=BR_det_da,'psi0(.)col(.)ext(.)p(year)'=BR_det_year,'psi0(.)col(.)ext(.)p(survey)'=BR_det_survey,'psi0(.)col(.)ext(.)p(baitdeg)'=BR_det_baitdeg,'psi0(.)col(.)ext(.)p(camera+survey)'=BR_det_survey_camera,'psi0(.)col(.)ext(.)p(survey+baitdeg)'=BR_det_survey_baitdeg,'psi0(.)col(.)ext(.)p(survey+baitdeg+camera)'=BR_det_survey_baitdeg_camera)

modSel(fms)

nd1<-data.frame(survey.cov=c('s01','s02','s03','s04','s05','s06','s07','s08','s09','s10','s11','s12','s13','s14','s15','s16','s17','s18','s19','s20','s21'),baitdeg=0)

E.det<-predict(BR_det_survey_baitdeg,type='det',newdata=nd1)

 

 

When using the predict function to calculate survey specific site occupancy for the highest ranking model (BR_det_survey_baitdeg) I get the following Error:

Error: ncol(coefficients) == length(obj@estimates) is not TRUE
